title: Revised Code of Washington, Title 59 (Landlord and Tenant), Chapter 59.18 - Residential Landlord-Tenant Act
verified_how: fetched https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=59.18 (HTTP 200): breadcrumb 'Home / State laws and rules / RCWs / Title 59 / Chapter 59.18', heading 'Chapter 59.18 RCW - RESIDENTIAL LANDLORD-TENANT ACT', section list running through RCW 59.18.750-.760 (Smart access systems - alternative keys / privacy policy / user data collection), 59.18.900 (Severability - 1973 1st ex.s. c 207), 59.18.911 (Effective date - 1989 c 342) and 59.18.912, followed by a reviser's note recording that the chapter was revised pursuant to Wash. Ass'n of Apartment Ass'ns v. Evans, 88 Wn.2d 563, 564 P.2d 788 (1977). Currency: the RCW index page (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/) states 'Last update: July 15, 2026' and explains that 'The online version of the RCW is updated twice a year, once in the early fall following the legislative session, and again at the end of the year if a ballot measure that changes the law passed at the general election'; it also records that 'The Statute Law Committee declares that the certified PDF publication documents in the RCW Archive area on the Office of the Code Reviser's website constitute the official publication of the Revised Code of Washington', so this HTML version is the working rather than the certified text. The register flags amended-but-not-yet-merged text by printing a section two or three times with '(as amended by 2026 c NN)' suffixes.
notes: General consumer protection is the separate chapter 19.86 RCW (Consumer Protection Act); only one statute may be listed per topic, so the tenancy statute is listed here as the narrower and more everyday one.
